title.value: TIE: A Framework for Embedding-based Incremental Temporal Knowledge Graph Completion
title.justification: The title is clearly stated at the beginning of the paper and is consistent with the research context throughout the document.
title.quote: TIE: A Framework for Embedding-based Incremental Temporal Knowledge Graph Completion

analysis.description: This paper presents the TIE framework, which is designed to enhance incremental learning in Temporal Knowledge Graph Completion (TKGC) by combining TKG representation learning, experience replay, and temporal regularization. The framework also introduces new metrics to evaluate model intransigence and efficiency in processing both historical and current knowledge. Experiments on benchmark datasets demonstrate the framework's significant improvements in training efficiency and knowledge retention compared to previous methods.

type.justification: The paper includes experimental results on datasets, which demonstrates that it is empirical in nature rather than focusing on theoretical framework development alone.
type.quote: Experimental results on Wikidata12k and YAGO11k datasets demonstrate that the proposed TIE framework reduces training time by about ten times...
